baseline_equation: ∇²Φ = 4πG(ρ_b + ρ_gas + ρ_halo); scored source object is halo-density component ρ_halo from no-bspline public model
kernel: 3D Plummer kernel K_d via phase2_g1.plummer3d_conv; no 2D kappa kernel used
object_X: ρ_halo only: no-bspline O1+O2 cluster-scale dPIE halo components; BCG/gas/potfile excluded
reference_object: bspline O2+O3 cluster-scale dPIE halo components; B-spline perturbation excluded from 3D dPIE density score
score_function: weighted log-MSE of 3D rho_halo and cumulative M_halo(<r) over 3-800 kpc against public bspline halo-component reference; not direct observation chi2

source.paper: Beauchesne et al. 2024 MNRAS AS1063 public Lenstool mass model
